title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Joshua 8: the ambush that took Ai and the altar and reading of the law at Mount Ebal.

questions.text: What were the Israelites allowed to do at Ai that differed from Jericho?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Joshua to do to Ai as he did to Jericho, except that they could take its goods and livestock for themselves.

answers.text: Take its goods and livestock for themselves
Spare the life of the king of Ai
Let all its people leave in peace
Leave the city standing as it was

questions.text: How many mighty men of valor did Joshua choose and send out by night?
questions.explanation: Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

questions.text: What did Joshua plan for his own group to do when the men of Ai came out?
questions.explanation: Joshua said that when the men of Ai came out against them as at the first, he and the people with him would flee before them.

questions.text: Where did the ambush stay that night?
questions.explanation: The ambush stayed between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai, while Joshua stayed among the people.

answers.text: East of the Jordan near Gilgal
South of Ai in the wilderness
Between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai

questions.text: Besides Ai, which city's men also went out after Israel and left their city open?
questions.explanation: Not a man was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel; they left the city open.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Joshua to stretch out toward Ai?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Joshua to stretch out the javelin in his hand toward Ai, and Joshua did so.

questions.text: What did the men of Ai see when they looked behind them?
questions.explanation: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw the smoke of the city going up to heaven.

answers.text: The smoke of their city rising up to heaven

questions.text: Where was the body of the king of Ai thrown at sundown?
questions.explanation: At sundown they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the city gate, and raised a heap of stones on it.

answers.text: At the entrance of the city gate

questions.text: On which mountain did Joshua build an altar to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal, an altar of uncut stones.

questions.text: Who were among the assembly when Joshua read all the words of the law?
questions.explanation: Joshua read every word Moses commanded before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners among them.

answers.text: Only the priests and the Levites
Only the elders and the judges
The women, the little ones, and the foreigners
Only the chosen men of war
